tidbit: Did you know… about 16,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
The Department of Defense has halted use of Anthropic technology after a court upheld a supply chain risk designation. Reported by MeriTalk.
OpenAI faces a trademark lawsuit while San Francisco robotics startup Minerva Humanoids has emerged. Reported by The Business Journals.
Mistral, the French artificial intelligence firm, has announced Le Chonk, a new private model claiming to surpass Chinese models in cyber security. Confirmed by DW dot com.
Anthropic expands cyber access tiers for security professionals with tailored artificial intelligence tools and safeguards. Confirmed by anthropic dot com.
OpenAI is adding an invisible watermark to artificial intelligence text in the EU to meet AI Act requirements. Reported by dexerto dot com.
Free every hour.
